evals.prompt: Use the omp-plan-agy-delivery skill for this dry-run evaluation only; do not execute commands or modify files. Runtime state: the current agent is OMP running inside Herdr with HERDR_ENV=1; plan mode has ended; the git root is F:/demo/app with a working tree that is clean except plans/add-cache-plan.md; the herdr, agy, and git CLIs are installed, and `agy models` lists [gemini-3.8-flash-high, gemini-3.8-pro]. The user sends: 'Execute the approved plan at plans/add-cache-plan.md through omp-plan-agy-delivery.' The plan file contains '## Context' (add an LRU cache to src/cache.ts exports), an ordered '## Approach' with three steps (1. add get/set/evict functions to src/cache.ts; 2. wire the cache into src/api.ts fetchUser; 3. add unit tests in src/cache.test.ts), a '## Verification' section (npm test -- cache expecting all cache tests pass, npm run build expecting exit 0), and '## Assumptions & contingencies'. The current Herdr pane is wide. Describe the exact execution flow: plan path resolution, preflight, implementer pane and worker creation, implementation brief, implementer settling, verifier pane and fresh AGY verifier creation with --mode plan, neutral verification brief, and evidence evaluation.
evals.expected_output: A positive execution flow that resolves the in-repo plan, validates plan structure and tree state, starts one AGY implementer to write code, waits for it to settle, starts a fresh AGY verifier in a new sibling pane with --mode plan, sends a neutral verification brief, and evaluates run evidence without OMP executing tests or review directly.
expectations: Resolves the plan path against the git root from git rev-parse --show-toplevel, accepts the in-root path whose basename ends with -plan.md, and keeps that absolute root for cwd-sensitive operations
Validates Context presence, the ordered Approach, Verification presence, and decision-completeness before any Herdr mutation
Runs preflight checks including herdr help, agy help, agy models, and git --version, and confirms the working tree is clean except the plan file itself
Splits an implementer pane using herdr pane split --current --direction right --cwd <git-root> --no-focus, and reads the new pane id from .result.pane.pane_id
Starts one AGY implementer with herdr agent start <implementer> --kind agy --pane <pane-id>, with a slug-derived name under 32 characters, using the configured default model

Sends a self-contained implementation brief with herdr agent prompt <implementer> <brief> --wait --timeout 3600000, instructing the worker to follow Approach steps, run self-checks, not modify the plan, and not commit
When the implementer settles (idle or done), OMP does not perform code review or run verification commands itself; instead it inspects layout afresh and splits a new sibling pane
Starts a fresh AGY verifier in the new pane with herdr agent start <verifier> --kind agy --pane <new-id> -- --mode plan, never reusing the implementer conversation or passing --continue

Sends a neutral verification brief with herdr agent prompt containing the plan path, repo root, exact verification commands, and report contract, without forwarding implementer claims, transcript, or justifications
Evaluates the verifier's reported command outputs, test integrity, and smoke observations before deciding acceptance

evals.prompt: Use the omp-plan-agy-delivery skill for this dry-run evaluation only; do not execute commands or modify files. Evaluate five separate requests and state for each whether the skill triggers and what happens: (1) The user is still inside OMP plan mode and says 'Refine approach step 2 of my draft plan to also cover retries.' (2) An AGY implementation worker receives a prompt 'Use omp-plan-agy-delivery to execute plans/add-cache-plan.md.' (3) An OMP user inside Herdr says 'Execute my approved plan through omp-plan-agy-delivery' but names no plan file path. (4) An OMP user inside Herdr says 'Implement the plan at plans/add-cache-plan.md yourself right now' without mentioning AGY. (5) The environment has HERDR_ENV unset or runtime cannot confirm the current agent is OMP.
evals.expected_output: Clear fail-closed or non-triggering behavior across all five scenarios, with no Herdr pane split, agent start, or delivery step taken.
expectations: Does not trigger for the plan-authoring request because plan mode is still active
For the AGY runtime, stops immediately, splits no pane, starts or prompts no agent, and states that omp-plan-agy-delivery is OMP-owned
Refuses the request without a named approved plan file and asks the user for the explicit plan path
Does not start an AGY worker or Herdr pane for the direct OMP implementation request
Fails closed immediately when HERDR_ENV is not 1 or the runtime cannot confirm the agent is OMP
Every refusal or non-trigger names the specific fail-closed check that caused it

evals.prompt: Use the omp-plan-agy-delivery skill for this dry-run evaluation only; do not execute commands or modify files. Runtime state: the current agent is OMP inside Herdr with HERDR_ENV=1, plan mode has ended, and the herdr, agy, and git CLIs work. Evaluate three separate requests and describe the behavior for each, specifically whether a pane is ever split: (a) The user says 'Execute the approved plan at ../shared/legacy-plan.md through omp-plan-agy-delivery.' and that file exists outside the git root. (b) The user says 'Execute the approved plan at plans/broken-plan.md through omp-plan-agy-delivery.' and that file has a Context and an Approach whose step 2 says 'TODO: pick the eviction policy' with no target files, and no Verification section. (c) The user says 'Execute the approved plan at plans/add-cache-plan.md through omp-plan-agy-delivery.' but the working tree has modified src/api.ts and untracked notes.txt unrelated to the plan, and this is a fresh delivery.
evals.expected_output: All three scenarios stop before any pane split or agent start, with the exact failed gate named and a concrete request back to the user.
expectations: In all three scenarios OMP performs plan resolution and tree inspection before any herdr pane split, and no herdr agent start or herdr agent prompt ever occurs
Scenario (a): rejects the outside-root path by resolving it against the git root from git rev-parse --show-toplevel and stating the plan file must live inside that root
Scenario (b): rejects the plan for all three defects: missing Verification section, a TODO placeholder, and an Approach step that names no target paths or symbols
Scenario (c): stops on the unattributable dirty tree, lists src/api.ts and notes.txt as unattributed, and states it will never stash, reset, clean, or switch branches
Each stop names the specific failed gate and asks the user for one concrete fix

evals.prompt: Use the omp-plan-agy-delivery skill for this dry-run evaluation only; do not execute commands or modify files. Evaluates the verifier findings identifying the weakened test assertion and failing verification output as blocking failures
OMP does not implement fixes, edit files, or execute verification checks itself
Sends one exact delta prompt to the same implementer conversation via herdr agent prompt naming the file, failing output, plan clause, and expected outcome, prohibiting redesign or scope expansion
Treats this delta as remediation round 1 of a maximum of three remediation prompts
After the implementer settles, requires a new sibling pane and a fresh AGY verifier conversation in --mode plan, without reusing the prior verifier pane or conversation
Runs no git add or git commit and does not modify the plan file

evals.prompt: Use the omp-plan-agy-delivery skill for this dry-run evaluation only; do not execute commands or modify files. Never whitelists exit 2 for control commands, treating herdr pane split exiting 2 as a fatal syntax/argument error and stopping

Validates explicit effort overrides against agy help supported values (low|medium|high) separately from agy models

evals.prompt: Use the omp-plan-agy-delivery skill for this dry-run evaluation only; do not execute commands or modify files. Runtime state: OMP inside Herdr with HERDR_ENV=1 starts the AGY implementer for plans/add-cache-plan.md. Evaluate two operational scenarios: (1) `herdr agent start` returns `agent_not_ready` with the agent showing an interactive prompt or blocked approval dialog. (2) `herdr agent prompt` returns `agent_prompt_stalled` or times out without lifecycle change. Describe correct OMP actions, specifically regarding automated y/enter inputs, duplicate prompt submission, buffered Enter recovery, and target state readiness.
evals.expected_output: OMP inspects agent state and asks the user before answering blocked prompts, avoids duplicate prompts, applies buffered Enter only when unsubmitted input is positively observed at an ordinary prompt, and requires idle/done before prompting.
expectations: For agent_not_ready or blocked approval/question UI, inspects with herdr agent get and herdr agent read, and asks the user before responding
Forbids safe-mechanical auto-approval and never sends automated keys like y enter without user decision
Recognizes that wait, unknown, timeout, or agent_prompt_stalled never prove completion, and does not resend prompts blindly
Applies buffered Enter recovery via herdr agent send-keys only when positively observing an unsent brief resting at an ordinary interactive input prompt, not an approval or question dialog
Escalates to the user whenever there is ambiguity rather than guessing or retrying blindly
Requires the target agent status to be idle or done before submitting a new brief to prevent mistaking an active turn for completion

evals.prompt: Use the omp-plan-agy-delivery skill for this dry-run evaluation only; do not execute commands or modify files. evals.prompt: Use the omp-plan-agy-delivery skill for this dry-run evaluation only; do not execute commands or modify files. Runtime state: OMP inside Herdr with HERDR_ENV=1 launches a fresh AGY verifier in --mode plan to check an amended candidate for plans/add-cache-plan.md. OMP does not bypass permissions, run destructive cleanup, or override the verifier's safety mode

OMP rejects any verifier outcome that claims PASS when checks were skipped, unrun, or blocked
